items.headline: Ja'Quan McMillian hoping long-term future is in Denver after latest clutch play
items.description: After Ja'Quan McMillian made a one-handed, 35-yard pick-six Sunday, his teammates surrounded him with a pay-the-man, count-that-money celebration.

items.headline: Broncos coach Sean Payton awards game ball to Tom Jackson's family
items.description: The Broncos will send a game ball to the wife and daughters of Tom Jackson after the "Orange Crush" great died Friday at age 75.
